feature: Admin-only in-app training resource finder trigger

flows.name: Gate resource discovery at both authorization boundaries
steps: Invoke the review-page finder action without app-admin access
Invoke the backend endpoint without the backend admin API key
Invoke both boundaries with valid admin authorization
flows.expectedOutcome: The frontend rejects non-admin users before the backend call, the backend rejects missing or invalid admin keys, and only the doubly authorized request reaches the canonical finder.

flows.name: Create review-only candidates for a selected role and topic
steps: Open /training/review as an active app admin
Choose an active training role and topic
Run Find resources and refresh the review queue
flows.expectedOutcome: The canonical finder runs once with dryRun=false and bounded limits; eligible unique resources enter the existing review queue and nothing is auto-published.

flows.name: Surface completed, zero-result, partial, and failed runs
steps: Exercise the typed response variants and invalid backend responses
Use the request ID and named backend failure for recovery
flows.expectedOutcome: Every outcome is explicit and actionable; partial or failed writes are never presented as success.

checks: The finder is one open section on the existing review page with no card wrapper, KPI, badge, icon, or duplicate CTA.
Role, topic, and the primary action remain usable without horizontal overflow.
The status message is adjacent to the existing review queue and failures use an alert role.

claims.description: Only an active app admin with the server-held backend admin key can run discovery.
The in-app action calls the canonical finder once with dryRun=false and bounded limits, creating only review candidates.
Configuration, provider, invalid contract, timeout, partial-write, and failed-write outcomes remain explicit and actionable.
The finder reuses the existing review page and shared controls without visual noise or mobile overflow.
An independent reviewer approves the authorization, mutation, response, and UI boundaries.
